name: Special Tile
tooltip: The first player to completely fill a 7x7 square of spaces on his quilt board receives this special tile, which is worth 7 buttons at the end of the game.

name: Special Tile
tooltip: The first player to completely fill a 7x7 square of spaces on his quilt board receives this special tile, which is worth 7 eyeballs at the end of the game.

name: Empties Counter
tooltip: Counter for remaining empty spaces. You will get 2 point penalty at the end of game per empty space.

name: Buttons Counter
tooltip:
Counter for buttons. You need buttons to buy patches. You will get 1 point for every button at the end of the game.

The smaller number is current button income.

name: Time Counter
tooltip: Counter for remaining time. You need time to buy patches or buttons. When your time runs out you game is over.

name: Eyeball Counter
tooltip:
Counter for eyeballs. You need eyeballs to buy patches. You will get 1 point for every eyeballs at the end of the game.

The smaller number is current eyeballs income.

name: Time Counter
tooltip: Counter for remaining time. You need time to buy patches or eyeballs. When your time runs out you game is over.
